findings.problem: The hint 'at school' does not rule out grade meaning school year, which is 'el grado' ('¿En qué grado estás?'), so the prompt has two right answers.

back.es: the grade, the mark (score on schoolwork); also a note
back.example: I got a good grade on the exam.

note: 'La calificación' is also common for a school grade, especially in Mexico, but 'la nota' is the everyday word across Latin America, so the card can keep it as the answer.
